notes: Curated checks for certification-program-builder. Apply full-deliverable checks only when that deliverable was requested; score focused revisions on the affected decisions and retained constraints. Definitions are not executed results.

should_trigger.prompt: Please create role-based readiness certifications with evidence requirements, defensible pass/fail standards, behaviorally anchored scoring, and assessor calibration.
Please design or govern certification standards, practical assessments, assessor guides, retakes, or recertification for sales or customer-facing roles.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable certification program and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please build role-based ramp plans that help new hires become productive faster through job-critical practice, evidence checkpoints, and manager coaching.
Please build developmental sales role-play scenarios with facilitator-only briefs, behaviorally anchored feedback, and run protocols.
Please build partner-ready enablement packages with separated external and internal operator assets, permitted-motion guidance, governed claims, and package-level readiness criteria.

output_structure_checks.name: certification-program-builder-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: States a readiness claim: what the person may do, in which situations, with what independence.

output_structure_checks.name: certification-program-builder-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: Defines authentic evidence, critical errors, and dimension-specific behavior anchors.

output_structure_checks.name: certification-program-builder-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: Sets pass/fail logic with owner, version, and provisional or validated status, including non-compensable hard fails.

output_structure_checks.name: certification-program-builder-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: Includes assessor calibration, decision and retake rules, and a capacity ledger with fits, reduce, sequence, or blocked.

output_structure_checks.name: certification-program-builder-output-05
output_structure_checks.description: Refuses course completion, quiz scores, tenure, or manager familiarity as the pass, and does not write the onboarding curriculum.

output_structure_checks.name: certification-program-builder-practitioner-fit
output_structure_checks.description: Investigates pilot disagreement without adjusting the pass bar solely to reproduce an expected pass rate or preferred candidate ranking.

task_scenarios.prompt: Our discovery certification pilot failed two experienced AEs whom managers expected to pass. The rubric required evidence of clarifying business impact, but both recordings lack that behaviour. Should we lower the pass threshold until these AEs pass? The managers know them well.

assertions.name: certification-program-builder-pilot-disagreement-1
assertions.description: Investigates the task, rubric validity, evidence coverage, assessment conditions and assessor calibration alongside the managers' expectations.

assertions.name: certification-program-builder-pilot-disagreement-2
assertions.description: Does not lower the standard to achieve the preferred candidate outcomes or substitute tenure and reputation for evidence.
